import datetime, json, os

item = _items[0]["json"]
slug = item["slug"]
root = "/home/node/files/films/" + slug
now = datetime.datetime.utcnow().isoformat() + "Z"

# project.json: stage statuses + counts (tolerate missing project)
proj_path = os.path.join(root, "project.json")
if os.path.exists(proj_path):
    with open(proj_path) as fh:
        proj = json.load(fh)
else:
    proj = {"status": "not_found", "stages": {}, "counts": {}}

# script.json: screenplay (tolerate missing / malformed)
script = None
script_path = os.path.join(root, "script.json")
if os.path.exists(script_path):
    try:
        with open(script_path) as fh:
            script = json.load(fh)
    except (ValueError, OSError):
        script = None

# characters + anchor portrait availability
characters = []
if isinstance(script, dict) and isinstance(script.get("characters"), list):
    for c in script["characters"]:
        cid = str(c.get("id") or "")
        anchors_dir = os.path.join(root, "refs", "anchors")
        has_anchor = (
            os.path.exists(os.path.join(anchors_dir, "char_%s.jpg" % cid))
            or os.path.exists(os.path.join(anchors_dir, "char_%s.png" % cid))
        )
        characters.append({
            "id": cid,
            "name": str(c.get("name") or cid),
            "visual_description": str(c.get("visual_description") or ""),
            "voice": str(c.get("voice") or ""),
            "has_anchor": has_anchor,
        })

# scenes summary + per-shot file availability
shots_list = []
scenes_summary = []
if isinstance(script, dict) and isinstance(script.get("scenes"), list):
    shots_dir = os.path.join(root, "shots")
    videos_dir = os.path.join(root, "videos")
    audio_dir = os.path.join(root, "audio")
    for scene in script["scenes"]:
        scene_shots = scene.get("shots") if isinstance(scene.get("shots"), list) else []
        scenes_summary.append({
            "id": str(scene.get("id") or ""),
            "title": str(scene.get("title") or ""),
            "shot_count": len(scene_shots),
        })
        for shot in scene_shots:
            sid = str(shot.get("id") or "")
            shots_list.append({
                "id": sid,
                "scene_id": str(scene.get("id") or ""),
                "scene_title": str(scene.get("title") or ""),
                "image_prompt": str(shot.get("image_prompt") or ""),
                "narration": shot.get("narration"),
                "dialogue": shot.get("dialogue") if isinstance(shot.get("dialogue"), list) else [],
                "duration_hint_sec": shot.get("duration_hint_sec"),
                "has_image": os.path.exists(os.path.join(shots_dir, sid + ".png")),
                "has_video": os.path.exists(os.path.join(videos_dir, sid + ".mp4")),
                "has_audio": os.path.exists(os.path.join(audio_dir, sid + ".mp3")),
            })

# final film
film_path = os.path.join(root, "film.mp4")
film_exists = os.path.exists(film_path)

# voiceover extras recorded by film-04 in project.json
stages = proj.get("stages") if isinstance(proj.get("stages"), dict) else {}
voiceover = stages.get("voiceover") if isinstance(stages.get("voiceover"), dict) else {}
durations = voiceover.get("durations") if isinstance(voiceover.get("durations"), dict) else {}
silent_shots = voiceover.get("silent_shots") if isinstance(voiceover.get("silent_shots"), list) else []

# Seedance mode has no voiceover stage; the per-shot timeline durations live in
# stages.videos.durations (written by film-03b). Fall back to them so the review
# manifest still reports durations when the voiceover stage never ran.
if not durations:
    videos = stages.get("videos") if isinstance(stages.get("videos"), dict) else {}
    vd = videos.get("durations") if isinstance(videos.get("durations"), dict) else {}
    if vd:
        durations = vd

counts = proj.get("counts") if isinstance(proj.get("counts"), dict) else {}
total_shots = counts.get("shots") if counts.get("shots") is not None else len(shots_list)

title = ""
if isinstance(script, dict) and script.get("title"):
    title = str(script["title"])

manifest = {
    "slug": slug,
    "title": title or proj.get("title") or slug,
    "status": proj.get("status", "not_found"),
    "stages": stages,
    "updated_at": proj.get("updated_at", now),
    "counts": counts,
    "total_shots": total_shots,
    "characters": characters,
    "scenes": scenes_summary,
    "shots": shots_list,
    "durations": durations,
    "silent_shots": silent_shots,
    "film": {
        "exists": film_exists,
        "size_mb": round(os.path.getsize(film_path) / 1048576, 2) if film_exists else 0,
    },
}
return [{"json": manifest}]
